newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 3.00-4.00 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 3.00-4.00 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar remained unchanged in a low 3.00-4.00 percent range on Sunday with the market still awash with surplus liquidity, dealers said.

Overnight funds opened at 3.00 percent amid excess funds with the market likely to open liquid on Monday with most lenders with surplus funds. Dealers said there was hardly any noticeable impact on the market of the latest 15 million dinar CD auction.
The market's excess liquidity sent rates tumbling to a 4.00 percent average last week from an above 8.00 percent level in the previous period.
